item.title: At least 24 killed in mosque terror attack in Pakistan
item.description: A powerful explosion ripped through a crowded Shiite mosque on the outskirts of Pakistan’s capital, Islamabad, on Friday, killing at least 24 people and injuring more than 100 others.
